evidence_kind: source and published-asset review; not release qualification

descriptor.format: stage_release.py --omp-component: omp component plus platforms map

asset_verification.method: Download each GitHub release asset; compute SHA-256 locally; compare with GitHub asset digest and downloaded SHA256SUMS.txt; identify executable format with file.
asset_verification.extraction: not applicable: upstream publishes raw executables, as for the 18.8.3 candidate; artifact_sha256 and binary_sha256 bind the same downloaded bytes

linux-x64.format: ELF 64-bit LSB executable x86-64, dynamically linked

release_notes_read.relevant_delta: Auth-broker and usage fixes; no listed change to the custom openai-responses fragments.
#14952 introduces optional per-model compaction points; #14630 fixes rust-analyzer/lspmux on Windows, not Responses request encoding.
Anthropic prompt-cache lookback/pruning and mid-turn status fixes; no new NInfer threshold setting inferred.
#14334 releases one-shot routing state; standalone native addons move from timestamped gzip tarballs to deterministic zstd frames. Published client assets remain raw executables.

unchanged_between_v18_8_3_and_v18_8_7.contract: providers.maxInFlightRequests acquisition and waiting before provider dispatch
include/reasoning compat and Responses image-detail encoding
configured per-provider in-flight limits forwarded on each request

routing_cleanup_review.finding: releaseSession normalizes and removes only chain/effort baselines with the supplied routing-session id. One-shot side requests release in finally only without conversationKey; main and keyed side-conversation lineages remain. The previous_response_id/delta-input append contract and stale-id/full-replay behavior are unchanged.
routing_cleanup_review.verdict: [inference] source-compatible with candidate per-model stateful chaining; source inspection is not route acceptance

compaction_review.finding: The new map modifies thresholdTokens/thresholdPercent only for a matching exact provider/model selector or longest trailing-star prefix. No match returns existing settings. asyncEnabled and the provider-cap waiting boundary are unchanged. Candidate config retains provider limits 2 for RTX 5090 and 1 for each native lane, with no asyncEnabled override.
compaction_review.recommendation: Keep existing compaction and concurrency settings. No 18.8.7 long-session or numeric-threshold tuning was measured; source support alone does not justify a new override.

probe_regression_evidence.red: candidate-descriptor environment regression test failed against predecessor probe because --client-component was unsupported
probe_regression_evidence.green: 18 focused test_stock_client_harness tests passed with Python 3.13; candidate descriptor and future published per-model manifest both omit PI_OPENAI_STATEFUL, while 18.4.10 retains it

verdict: verified upstream client candidate only; runtime/model pins unchanged; qualification and documented-route acceptance remain pending

stateful_class_closure.rule: 18.8.x epoch and later omit PI_OPENAI_STATEFUL even when inherited or qualified; historical 18.4.x launches retain =1; receipts project the selected launch environment
stateful_class_closure.red: 20 client-harness tests: six expected failures across the three RPC drivers and their receipt fields before the shared contract
stateful_class_closure.green: 20 client-harness tests and 74 verifier tests passed with Python 3.13, including real subprocess environment checks for candidate-descriptor and future manifest paths

local_rehearsal.coverage: typed tool turn, exact continuation, fail-closed request and served runtime identity; not a route acceptance or long-session/compaction qualification
